title.zh: 心理卫生（护理与治疗）（指定精神病院）公告 2010
title.en: Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Designated Psychiatric Institution) Notification 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Designated Psychiatric Institution) Notification 2010 and shall come into operation on 1st March 2010.
2. The Minister hereby designates the Institute of Mental Health to be a psychiatric institution for the detention and treatment of mentally disordered persons under the Act.
